_key_type_source.reason: Upstream cosmos/chain-registry has slip44 60 and omits key_algos; the chain's own source sets coin type 996 and defaults keys to eth_secp256k1.
evidence: https://github.com/okex/exchain/blob/a0a25945fe0366f89e08b67746950116ba79cbc2/app/types/config.go (Bip44CoinType = 996, BIP44HDPathOKExChain = m/44'/996'/0'/0/0; applied by SetBip44CoinType in cmd/exchaind/main.go)
https://github.com/okex/exchain/blob/a0a25945fe0366f89e08b67746950116ba79cbc2/cmd/client/keys.go (keys add default algo set to eth_secp256k1; keyring built with hd.EthSecp256k1Options())
